paragraphs.text: Fannessa Fjyorne is a Strixhaven student and Oriq cultist on the plane of Arcavios .

Fannessa Fjyorne is a striking individual with long, dark braids and lavender-tinted eyes that contrast with her mahogany skin. Her presence is compelling, with a gravity that draws others' attention. She has a dual nature, effortlessly shifting from bubbly and animated to calculating and mysterious. Fannessa's demeanor is marked by a playful yet probing attitude, often making incisive comments and observing others with keen interest. Her personality exudes a blend of empathy and manipulation, showing solidarity in moments of vulnerability but also revealing a more sinister side as she manipulates situations to her advantage.

Fannessa was initially seen giving Killian Lu an empathetic smile during a violent match against Razineth , providing a brief moment of solidarity. Later, she encountered Killian on a boat and engaged in a probing conversation, revealing her interest in his abilities and the harshness of their training. Fannessa then offered Killian a drink, which suppressed his guilt and enhanced his aggression during a duel with Vickus. She watched the duel with devilish delight, urging Killian to embrace a more ruthless approach, wanting him to kill Vickus. After the duel, Fannessa confronted Killian in the bathroom, revealing her true identity as an Oriq agent and attempting to recruit him. She manipulated him with Oriq magic, trying to convince him to join their cause. When Killian refused, she attacked him, but he ultimately repelled her with his light magic, infusing her with mercy. Fannessa was then taken away by a mage hunter, leaving Killian to confront the ongoing battle outside.
